description: As a fleet administrator, I want to edit the details of an existing vehicle so that I can keep the fleet registry accurate.

acs.text: Clicking Edit on a vehicle row opens the Edit Vehicle form pre-filled with existing values.
Vehicle ID is read-only in edit mode — it cannot be changed.
On Save, the updated values appear in the fleet list immediately.

sections.content: Edit icon is in the Actions column of each fleet list row. The Edit form uses the same layout as Add Vehicle but with Vehicle ID field disabled.
